title: Hypothesis Testing
summary: Hypothesis tests ask whether data are surprising under a null hypothesis.

key_concepts.explanation: The default claim that there is no effect.
The probability of data at least this extreme if the null is true.

outline.heading: The procedure
points: State the null and alternative hypotheses.
Compute a test statistic and its p-value.

outline.heading: Errors
points: A type one error rejects a true null.
A type two error misses a real effect.

assignments.task: Run a t-test on the lab data

questions: Does a small p-value prove the effect is large?
